claims.claim: A transient fetch failure is negatively cached as kind=negative-transient with a SHORT ttl (0.25s); while the entry is live the retry makes zero network calls; after the ttl expires the very next get() hits the network again (fetch counter +1).

A genuine absence (404 fixture) is negatively cached as kind=negative-genuine for its FULL ttl (5.0s) and stays cached across two SHORT-ttl windows without refetching; the recorded type distinguishes it from a transient blip.

Regression seed: the broken semantics (empty result reported OK on a failed fetch, measured on this estate with a fixture-local fetch) are detectable - the probe reproduces the empty-OK shape and asserts on it before trusting the real cache.

negative_controls.description: The seeded empty-OK cache returns None with no error on a failed fetch; the probe asserts this broken shape is observable (fetched once, reported None) so a silent-OK cache cannot pass as correct.
negative_controls.good_state_output: real cache raises TransientFetchError / NotFoundError with typed negative entries
